skill_name: Develop a plan to reduce your carbon footprint.
workflow: A great plan to reduce your carbon footprint is to use renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power. You should also look into energy efficiencies like using LED lighting, sealing air leaks and installing insulation in your home, or if you're able to, switch to an electric vehicle. You can also reduce your energy consumption by making small and simple changes such as washing your clothes in cold water, turning off unneeded lights, and unplugging electronics when they're not in use.
